title: FACS-based calcium mobilization assay
protocol: Label peripheral blood-derived neutrophils with fluo-4 AM in assay buffer for 45 min at 37°C.
Add stimulus to the cells and record the change in mean fluorescent intensity (MFI) for 120 s using the BD FACSAria System.
For determining desensitization, add a second stimulus at time 130 s and measure another 120 s.
